turn_text: We left the villages. That going-out was not escape - it was the most demanding engagement we knew. The cell was where the combat happened, and the one who fled to it fled toward the struggle, not away from it.

Asked what it meant, he said: "My sins run out behind me, and I do not see them, and today I am coming to judge the errors of another." The assembly forgave the brother.
